images.title: 30 marbles and 5 bags
images.purpose: Show that 30 + (5 × 4) means the 30 stay, and only the bags are multiplied.
images.composition: A left block for the 30, a plus sign, and a group of five bags on the right, with the expression centred below.
exact_structure: Left: one large rounded rectangle with grey #6B7280 outline, containing only the label 30 (no individual marbles drawn).
A plus sign between the two groups.
Right: five identical bag shapes in a row, dark outline, light amber #E69F00 fill, each containing exactly 4 small teal #0072B2 circles in a 2 by 2 square.
A reddish purple #CC79A7 bracket around the five bags only, labelled 5 × 4.
rejection: a bag with a number of marbles other than 4
images.takeaway: The bracket shows which part is worked out first: 5 × 4, then add 30.
images.description: A block of 30 beside five bags of 4 marbles, with the bags bracketed.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text on the order of work.
images.teaching_notes: Count the marbles in one bag, then the bags, before adding the 30.

image_decisions.why: Seeing which part is grouped makes the order of work meaningful.
